claims.text: Tate Modern is an enormous art gallery that houses the United Kingdom's national collection of international modern and contemporary art.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: The incredible museum is actually located inside the massive industrial structure of the former Bankside Power Station.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Since the gallery first opened to the public in 2000, its vast collections have intentionally been arranged thematically rather than in chronological order.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: It has grown to become one of the largest museums of modern and contemporary art in the world, exclusively featuring works created from or after 1900.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: In 2025 alone, the museum welcomed an astonishing 4,514,266 visitors, making it the most popular art gallery in the entire country.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Best of all, like many other national galleries in the UK, there is no admission charge to view the main collection displays.
claims.subject: self
